description: This file defines a BroadcastReceiver class 'PrayerAlarmReceiver' that handles prayer alarm notifications by creating and displaying notifications when a prayer alarm intent is received.

classes.name: PrayerAlarmReceiver
classes.description: A BroadcastReceiver that handles prayer alarm intents by creating and posting notifications about upcoming prayers.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles received broadcast intents; verifies intent action; retrieves prayer details; ensures notification channel exists; checks notification permission; creates intent to open main app; builds and displays notification.
